descriptions.lag: sales k days before the target day (k >= h)
descriptions.roll_mean_7: mean sales over the 7 days ending h days before the target
descriptions.roll_mean_28: mean sales over the 28 days ending h days before the target
descriptions.roll_std_28: std of sales over the same 28 days
descriptions.roll_zero_28: share of zero-sales days in the same 28 days (intermittency)
descriptions.price: listed price on the target day (known-in-advance covariate)
descriptions.price_ratio_7: price / price 7 days earlier (promotion / price change)
descriptions.price_rel_hist: price / mean listed price up to t-h (relative discount)
descriptions.listed_days: number of days the item has had a listed price up to the target day
descriptions.snap: SNAP benefit day flag for the store's state

excluded.year: non-stationary; test year not seen in training
excluded.MAPE/sMAPE: not applicable: 59.6% of kept days are zero
